Calls sub_53CBC0 passing a2 as an output dword pointer and a1 as an argument; when the callee returns non-zero, clears the dword pointed to by a2, and returns the callee's result unchanged. Called by BitmapLoader (0x004979F0), consistent with a post-decode validation step that invalidates an output field on failure.
